why_not_a_full_pass: The race detector was never executed. This is an environment block, and an environment block is NOT evidence that the project has no data races.
SM2 key agreement still has no independent implementation cross-check.
what_is_verified: 158 top-level tests and 175 subtests pass; 0 failures; go test real exit code 0.
The summarizer certifies that run as PASS over 14 expected packages with the real exit code supplied.

The traditional end-to-end run was verified by the shared strict verifier: both endpoints authenticated each other, agreed on one full 32-hex session id, negotiated suite 1, and produced exactly 3 telemetry/control/acknowledgement cycles with matching sample and operation ids and no unacknowledged control.
27 structured negative cases were rejected at the expected stage, with per-endpoint channel state and null for unobserved values.
All cryptographic and trust checks from M2 are unchanged: real SM2 signature and full SM2 key exchange, HKDF-SM3, real SM4-GCM, sequence numbers never rolled back.
may_proceed_note: The M2.1 fixes are in and their regressions pass, which is the stated gate for starting M3 locally. The two verification gaps must be closed before any deployment or any claim of complete verification.
must_not_be_reported_as: evidence that the project has no data races
